lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular spots are arranged in a semi-regular grid posterior to the gill slits, forming approximately five identifiable horizontal rows and multiple vertical columns of varying intensity.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of blobs, creating a grid-like pattern where high-intensity spots are centered at the intersection points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible along the upper flank, defined by a sharp intensity gradient featuring high-luminance peaks and low-luminance shadows immediately ventral to the ridge lines.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct reddish-pink circular mark is visible on the upper flank, positioned dorsally to the first gill slit. Faint irregular white markings are present along the anterior margin of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density cluster of smaller, irregularly spaced high-luminance spots that differ in spatial frequency from the larger, more organized grid on the lateral flank.
